latestVersion.changelog:
AI Tool for Video Creation — Initial Release

- Create MP4 videos from your images, audio, and text prompts through a cloud AI pipeline.
- Supports uploads of MP4, MOV, JPG, PNG, and other popular formats up to 500MB.
- No editing skills required — just describe the video you want, and the AI generates it in 1-2 minutes.
- Automatic session setup with free token for new users; 100 credits included.
- Supports export, credits checking, and session management via simple chat commands.
- Ideal for marketers and content creators seeking fast, professional-looking video results.
